note: Kali 2026.1 dedicated manifest. Built on the 2025.4 + 2026.1 new-tool sets. Most tools ship preinstalled; bootstrap mainly handles non-preinstalled tools and MCP registration.
kaliNewTools2026_1: adaptixc2 — post-exploitation and adversary emulation framework (apt install adaptixc2)
atomic-operator — Atomic Red Team test executor (apt install atomic-operator)
fluxion — WiFi social-engineering audit tool (apt install fluxion)
gef — enhanced GDB debugging framework (apt install gef)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp)
sstimap — automated SSTI detection tool (apt install sstimap)
wpprobe — WordPress plugin enumeration (apt install wpprobe)
xsstrike — advanced XSS scanner (apt install xsstrike)
kaliNewTools2025_4: bpf-linker — BPF static linker (apt install bpf-linker)
evil-winrm-py — Python-based WinRM remote execution (apt install evil-winrm-py)
hexstrike-ai — AI MCP security automation platform (apt install hexstrike-ai)
kaliNativeMCP: mcp-kali-server — official Kali MCP Server, connects the AI to the Kali terminal (apt install mcp-kali-server, port 5000)
metasploitmcp — Metasploit MCP Server (apt install metasploitmcp, port 8085)
hexstrike-ai — MCP automation across 150+ security tools (apt install hexstrike-ai)

capabilities.name: jadx
capabilities.kaliNote: Not preinstalled on Kali; download from the GitHub Release

capabilities.name: apktool
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install apktool is enough; if the version is old, fetch the latest from GitHub

capabilities.name: frida
capabilities.kaliNote: pip3 install frida-tools or apt install python3-frida-tools

capabilities.name: idalib-mcp
postInstallSteps: Restart IDA Pro so the plugin takes effect
After IDA opens a file, the MCP listens on 127.0.0.1:13337 automatically
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires the Linux build of IDA Pro

capabilities.name: jeb-pro
capabilities.manualInstallHint: JEB Pro is commercial. Obtain a valid license from PNF Software, install it manually, then refresh the tool index. Optional community MCP bridges must pass the skill-supply-chain review before registration.
capabilities.kaliNote: JEB Pro Linux edition requires a user-provided license and manual installation.

capabilities.name: reqable-mcp
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires the separately installed Reqable desktop application and its local API.

capabilities.name: xquik-mcp
capabilities.note: Registers the first-party remote MCP URL only. OAuth is completed in the MCP client. No local package, bridge, or credential is installed.

capabilities.name: idapro
capabilities.portNote: The port increments when multiple IDA instances run (13337→13338→...); check the [MCP] port=xxxxx line in the IDA Output window
capabilities.kaliNote: Requires IDA Pro for Linux, installed into /opt/idapro/

capabilities.name: r2
capabilities.kaliNote: Preinstalled on Kali. For the latest version, download the .deb from GitHub

capabilities.name: rabin2
capabilities.kaliNote: Installed together with radare2

capabilities.name: adb
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install adb

capabilities.name: ghidra-mcp
postInstallSteps: Install the plugin zip into Ghidra: File → Install Extensions → select the downloaded zip
The MCP server listens on localhost:8765 automatically once a Ghidra project is open
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install ghidra or download from GitHub

capabilities.name: seclists
capabilities.kaliNote: apt install seclists; installs into /usr/share/seclists/

capabilities.name: burpsuite-mcp
capabilities.manualInstallHint: BurpSuite ships with Kali; search the extension marketplace for the MCP plugin, install it, and it listens on localhost:9876
capabilities.kaliNote: Kali ships BurpSuite Community; the MCP plugin must be installed manually
